checks.name: template-catalog
checks.summary: Operator-owned task catalog loaded with signed template digests.

checks.name: raw-exec-denied
checks.summary: Task-only identity cannot acquire a raw execution lease.

checks.name: input-schema-denied
checks.summary: JSON Schema rejects parameters outside the operator contract.

checks.name: self-approval-denied
checks.summary: A dual-role identity still cannot approve its own plan.

checks.name: approval-review
checks.summary: Independent approver sees parameters bound to immutable hashes.

checks.name: independent-approval
checks.summary: Independent approver authorizes the exact reviewed plan.

checks.name: idempotent-submit
checks.summary: Repeated submission returns the original task instead of executing twice.

checks.name: receipt-gated
checks.summary: Receipt is unavailable until execution and sandbox cleanup finish.

checks.name: task-started
checks.summary: Task was scheduled into a real CubeSandbox MicroVM.

checks.name: output-policy
checks.summary: Allowlisted metrics are returned while model content remains digest-only.

checks.name: cleanup-verified
checks.summary: The MicroVM was killed before a final receipt was issued.

checks.name: receipt-signature
checks.summary: Canonical receipt signature verifies offline and includes cleanup evidence.

checks.name: receipt-get-post
checks.summary: GET and POST receipt transports return the same signed evidence.

checks.name: denied-plan-blocked
checks.summary: A denied plan cannot be submitted.

checks.name: expired-plan-blocked
checks.summary: Expired plans cannot be approved or replayed.

checks.name: invalid-output-blocked
checks.summary: Invalid task output fails closed, but still produces cleanup evidence.

checks.name: cancel-and-cleanup
checks.summary: Cancellation terminates the job and verifies MicroVM cleanup.

checks.name: operator-auto-task
checks.summary: An explicitly configured no-approval template follows its declared policy.
